name: herdr
description: Herdr workflow skill for a Jira ticket's workspace lifecycle. /ticket open SE-1234 opens a Herdr tab for the ticket — Claude Code agent left, console top-right, Codex agent bottom-right — and seeds both agents with the ticket content fetched via the Atlassian MCP. /ticket close [SE-1234] [PR#] closes out finished work: reconciles its docs, updates the Jira ticket, and tears down the worktree.
